name: The Peninsula New York
positioning: Midtown hotel at Fifth Avenue and 55th Street, steps from Central Park, with a rooftop bar, a glass-enclosed pool and a spa
best_for: Shoppers and theatergoers who want a Fifth Avenue base in Midtown
Suite guests who want a chauffeured car for city outings

facts.text: The hotel is at 700 Fifth Avenue at 55th Street, New York.
The hotel is steps from Central Park.
The hotel has convenient access to Rockefeller Center, Fifth Avenue shopping, museums and Broadway theaters.
A property-wide refurbishment led by New York City-based Bill Rooney Studio began in January 2024 and included the Lobby, Reception, Palm Court and the rooftop lounge, Pen Top.
Clement Restaurant serves American fare across three themed rooms.
Clement was designed by Yabu Pushelberg.
Clement serves a Saturday brunch and a Sunday Brunch Buffet.
The Gotham Lounge serves afternoon tea and offers classic cocktails and live piano.
Pen Top is the hotel's rooftop bar and terrace.
The swimming pool is glass-enclosed, with floor-to-ceiling teak columns, and poolside dining is available.
The spa includes a Private Spa Suite, separate men's and women's relaxation lounges and a tea lounge.
The fitness center has Technogym equipment and a sunlit studio with complimentary daily group classes; hotel guests get complimentary pool and fitness center access.

highlights.text: In Clement's Color Room, guests dine surrounded by a sixty-foot-long hand-etched mural of a jungle growing over New York buildings, titled Wild New York.
The Grand Suite occupies a 20th-floor corner overlooking Fifth Avenue, with views of Central Park.
The spa's aromatherapy steam room, sauna, ice fountain and experience shower are set against a 24-karat gold mosaic by Bisazza.
Guests staying in a suite can use a chauffeur-driven MINI Cooper S Clubman as a complimentary amenity.
Deluxe Suites are one-bedroom corner suites with Fifth Avenue views, a decorative fireplace and a dining table.

considerations.text: Superior Rooms look onto an interior courtyard.
Guests must be 18 or older to use the fitness facility, and children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult at the pool.
WhataHotel notes the busy Midtown location comes with typical New York street noise.
